title: Export resolveI18nLabel and fix i18n label type errors in plugin-designer
body:
`NavigationItem.label` is typed as `string | { key; defaultValue?; params? }` but several files treat it as a plain `string`, causing TS2322/TS2339 build failures across `plugin-designer` and `components`. - **`packages/react/src/index.ts`** — Export `resolveI18nLabel` from `./utils/i18n`. It was defined but not re-exported, breaking imports in `breadcrumb.tsx` and `header-bar.tsx`. - **`packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx`** — Resolve i18n labels to strings at all 5 usage sites (state init, commit handler, escape reset, display render, preview render). - **`packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx`** — Wrap `item.label` with `resolveI18nLabel()` in nav preview list. ```tsx // Before — TS error: i18n object not assignable to ReactNode {item.label} // After {resolveI18nLabel(item.label)} ```
